text:
Situation: Ondansetron hydrochloride is not on FDA's drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Current inventory across three sites provides between 15.4 and 29.9 days on hand for the 4 mg tablet. Corvale General has the lowest coverage at 15.4 days for one lot, though a second lot at that site extends to 29.9 days.

Why (FDA record): FDA's records show ondansetron hydrochloride is not listed on the drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Supply is adequate in the near term but uneven across sites. No FDA regulatory action is recorded before a posting at a registered plant. The buyer should verify current allocation and contract terms with existing suppliers before pursuing new purchases.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer verifies allocation and contract terms with current suppliers; requires approval from Pharmacy Director.
2. Buyer evaluates purchase from Advanced Rx Pharmacy of Tennessee, LLC if supplemental supply is needed; requires approval from Pharmacy Director and P&T Committee.
3. Buyer evaluates purchase from Advanced Rx of Tennessee, LLC if supplemental supply is needed; requires approval from Pharmacy Director and P&T Committee.
4. Buyer evaluates purchase from Ascend Laboratories, LLC if supplemental supply is needed; requires approval from Pharmacy Director and P&T Committee.
5. Buyer evaluates purchase from Aurobindo Pharma Limited if supplemental supply is needed; requires approval from Pharmacy Director and P&T Committee.
6. Buyer evaluates purchase from AvKARE if supplemental supply is needed; requires approval from Pharmacy Director and P&T Committee.

Not recommended: No immediate clinical formulary changes or conservation protocols; those decisions rest with treating clinicians and the committee.
